pairTitles: 太阳也不是最大的恒星
还有比大角星大得多的恒星
pairNotes: 木星的直径约是地球的 11 倍。这里比的是直径，不是质量，也不是两者之间的距离。
太阳的直径约是木星的 10 倍。木星仍是刚才那一颗，只是两者一起用了更小的显示比例。
大角星是红巨星，直径约是太阳的 25 倍。它的大小是估计值；恒星大小不同，这不是“最大恒星”排行榜。
心宿二的直径估计约是太阳的 700 倍，大约能横着排下 28 颗大角星。这是大小估计，不是“宇宙最大恒星”的排名。
大犬座 VY 的直径约是心宿二的 2 倍。这里采用 2012 年干涉观测结合大气模型得到的光球半径估计：1420 ± 120 个太阳半径；画面取中心值。不把外围气体和尘埃算成恒星表面，也不把它称作已确定的最大恒星。
zh.boundary: 圆盘直径使用同一比例；摆放间隔只为比较。恒星的颗粒、暗斑与辉光是静态表面示意，并非观测照片；颜色和纹理尺度不用于测量。

homeTitles: 太阳和行星组成一个系统
太阳系在银河的恒星盘里
银河也是星系群的一员
homeNotes: 太阳是恒星，地球和其他行星绕着它运行。太阳系的范围包含很长的轨道距离，不能把它当作一颗更大的球。
银河里有许多恒星，太阳只是其中一颗。黄色标记指出太阳系所在的大致区域；这个标记不代表太阳系的真实大小。
保留刚才的银河，再找到仙女座星系和三角座星系。本星系群还有更多成员；这里仅展示三个代表。
zh.homeBoundary: 包含关系示意 · 星盘、旋臂、中央亮区与尘埃暗带为结构重建，并非从银河外拍摄的照片。形状、朝向、间距和标记不用于测量；星系不是实心球。

pairTitles: The Sun makes Jupiter look small
The Sun is not the largest star
pairNotes: Jupiter is about 11 Earth diameters across. We compare diameter, not mass or the distance between them.
The Sun is about 10 Jupiter diameters across. This is the same Jupiter, with both objects now drawn at a smaller common scale.
Arcturus is a red giant about 25 Sun diameters across. Its size is estimated; this is not a ranking of the largest stars.
Antares is estimated at about 700 Sun diameters, or roughly 28 Arcturus diameters across. This is an approximate size, not a ranking of the largest stars.

VY Canis Majoris is about twice the diameter of Antares. We use a 2012 photospheric-radius estimate from interferometry and an atmosphere model: 1420 ± 120 solar radii, drawing the central value. Surrounding gas and dust are not counted as the stellar surface; this is not a claim that it is the largest star.
en.boundary: Disk diameters share one scale; spacing is for comparison. Stellar granules, dark spots and glow are static surface illustrations, not observed photographs; colors and texture sizes are not measurements.

homeTitles: The Sun and planets form a system
Our Solar System belongs to the galactic disk
The Milky Way belongs to a group
homeNotes: The Sun is a star, with Earth and other planets orbiting it. The system spans large orbital distances; it is not a bigger solid ball.
The galaxy contains many stars; our Sun is one of them. The yellow marker indicates our approximate region, not the Solar System’s physical size.
Keep track of the Milky Way, then find Andromeda and Triangulum. The Local Group has many more members; these are only three representatives.
en.homeBoundary: Membership illustration · Disks, spiral arms, central light and dust lanes are structural reconstructions, not photographs taken outside the Milky Way. Shapes, orientations, spacing and markers are not measurements; galaxies are not solid balls.
